testResults.name: bars-and-session-scheduler
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest tests/harness/data/test_bars.py tests/harness/core/test_scheduler.py -q
testResults.result: 5 tests passed for exact OHLCV reconciliation, absolute and recurring callbacks, New York session-relative callbacks, normal-session DST conversion, half-day markers, and duplicate suppression.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; all scheduling uses explicit SimClock timestamps and exchange-calendar session contracts.

decisions: Bars are half-open UTC intervals with Decimal prices/volume and source timestamp/sequence/feed ordering.
Session callbacks convert New York wall intent through ZoneInfo and schedule explicit UTC bus events once per session marker.
